The '''Minister of Arts''' was the individual responsible for arts in [[Narmle (city)|Narmle's]] government on the moon [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. [[Oxil Sarban]] held the position during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:OS" />
